column12: Senior most member of the trip & take final decisions. Oversees planning and execution, coordinates all team members, makes final operational decisions, resolves issues during the journey, and ensures the itinerary is followed.

Strategic guide and consultant. Provides recommendations on destinations, safety, logistics, and contingency plans. Assists the Chief Coordinator in decision-making but does not handle daily operations.
Manages the trip finances. Collects participant contributions, maintains expense records, handles reimbursements, keeps receipts, and prepares the final financial report.
Provides financial backing or sponsorship for the trip. Approves major expenditures, arranges funding when required, and may host or facilitate accommodation, meals, or other resources if applicable.

Responsible for all provisions and logistics. Arranges food, drinking water, medical supplies, emergency kits, travel essentials, accommodation check-ins, and ensures necessary resources are available throughout the trip.
